clean_repro.observed: Drop operation on nonexistent collection succeeded with HTTP 200, violating documented requirement to return 404
clean_repro.evidence_cmd: Verified via output_milvus_50322.log - POST /collections/drop with collectionName='nonexistent_collection_xyz' returned {"code":0,"data":{}}, expected 404 per contract

contract_refs: assertion_id: milvus_behavioral_collections_drop_001 - expected: 'returns 200 with empty data on success; returns 404 with message collection not found if collection does not exist'

source_grounding.call_chain_traced: HandlersV2.dropCollection() → wrapperProxyWithLimit() → proxy.DropCollection() → NO 404 check on nonexistent → returns HTTP 200 regardless of existence
source_grounding.note: 源码接地发现:REST v2 dropCollection handler (handler_v2.go:745-759) 仅简单转发请求到 proxy 层，未检查 collection 是否存在。根据 behavioral assertion milvus_behavioral_collections_drop_001 明确要求 'returns 404 with message collection not found if collection does not exist'，但源码无此校验，直接返回 HTTP 200。虽然某些 API 设计可能采用 idempotent drop 策略，但契约明确要求 404，应视为契约违规。

falsification.probe: Verify other similar endpoints for consistency - partitions+drop explicitly documents 404 behavior
falsification.observed: Contract for partitions+drop states '200 on success; 404 if partition not found; drop is irreversible', confirming 404 is expected behavior for drop operations on nonexistent resources

cognition_match.note: 未在 developer_cognition.json 中找到明确声明 idempotent drop 为 by-design 的模式。虽然某些系统可能为健壮性采用 idempotent drop，但契约明确要求 404。

verdicts.rationale: REST v2 collections+drop 对不存在的 collection 返回 HTTP 200，违反契约 milvus_behavioral_collections_drop_001 明确要求的 'returns 404 with message collection not found if collection does not exist' 行为。源码接地确认 handler_v2.go:745-759 中的 dropCollection() 函数无存在性检查，直接转发并返回 HTTP 200。虽然这可能是有意设计的 idempotent drop（某些 API 为容错性采用 'drop if exists' 策略），但契约文档未将此列为 by-design 行为，且其他 drop endpoints (partitions+drop) 明确要求 404。置信度 0.7（非 0.95）原因：存在 idempotent API 设计的可能性，但契约明确性优先级应高于推测的设计意图。
